hooks.command: osascript -e 'display notification "Claude Code needs your attention" with title "Claude Code"'

statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); project_dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.project_dir'); if [[ "$cwd" == "$project_dir"/* ]] || [[ "$cwd" == "$project_dir" ]]; then display_dir="${cwd#$project_dir}"; display_dir="${display_dir#/}"; [[ -z "$display_dir" ]] && display_dir="."; else display_dir=$(basename "$cwd"); fi; git_info=""; if git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo "detached"); if ! git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks diff-index --quiet HEAD -- 2>/dev/null; then dirty="*"; else dirty=""; fi; git_info=" ${branch}${dirty}"; fi; ctx_info=""; usage=$(echo "$input" | jq '.context_window.current_usage'); if [ "$usage" != "null" ]; then current=$(echo "$usage" | jq '.input_tokens + .cache_creation_input_tokens + .cache_read_input_tokens'); size=$(echo "$input" | jq '.context_window.context_window_size'); pct=$((current * 100 / size)); ctx_info=" ${pct}%"; fi; printf "\033[34m%s\033[0m\033[90m%s\033[0m\033[33m%s\033[0m" "$display_dir" "$git_info" "$ctx_info"
